mapper.select: select id, name, cover_url as cover, type, description from recite_playlist where status = 1 and type = #{type} order by sort_no asc, id asc

select id, playlist_id as playlistId, poem_id as poemId, item_title as title, item_subtitle as subtitle, cover_url as cover, audio_url as audioUrl, false as up from recite_playlist_item where playlist_id = #{playlistId} order by sort_no asc, id asc

select id, playlist_id as playlistId, title, author, thumbnail, video_url as videoUrl, duration, quality, views, tags, description from recite_playlist_video where playlist_id = #{playlistId} order by sort_no asc, id asc

select id, playlist_id as playlistId, poem_id as poemId, item_title as title, item_subtitle as subtitle, cover_url as cover, audio_url as audioUrl, false as up from recite_playlist_item where item_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or item_subtitle like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by id desc limit 30

select id, playlist_id as playlistId, title, author, thumbnail, video_url as videoUrl, duration, quality, views, tags, description from recite_playlist_video where title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or author like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or tags like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by views desc, id desc limit 30

select rp.id, rp.name, rp.cover_url as cover, rp.type, rp.description from recite_favorite rf join recite_playlist rp on rp.id = rf.target_id where rf.user_id = #{userId} and rf.favorite_type = 'playlist' and rp.status = 1 order by rf.create_time desc, rf.id desc

select i.id, i.playlist_id as playlistId, i.poem_id as poemId, i.item_title as title, i.item_subtitle as subtitle, i.cover_url as cover, i.audio_url as audioUrl, false as up from recite_favorite rf join recite_playlist_item i on i.id = rf.target_id where rf.user_id = #{userId} and rf.favorite_type = 'audio' order by rf.create_time desc, rf.id desc

select rpv.id, rpv.title, rpv.author, rpv.thumbnail, rpv.video_url as videoUrl, rpv.duration, rpv.quality, rpv.views, rpv.tags, rpv.description, true as favorited from recite_favorite rf join recite_playlist_video rpv on rpv.id = rf.target_id where rf.user_id = #{userId} and rf.favorite_type = 'video' order by rf.create_time desc, rf.id desc

select rp.id, rp.name, rp.cover_url as cover, rp.type, rp.description from recite_recent_play rrp join recite_playlist rp on rp.id = rrp.playlist_id where rrp.user_id = #{userId} and rrp.playlist_id is not null and rp.status = 1 group by rp.id, rp.name, rp.cover_url, rp.type, rp.description order by max(rrp.play_time) desc limit 20

select i.id, i.playlist_id as playlistId, i.poem_id as poemId, i.item_title as title, i.item_subtitle as subtitle, i.cover_url as cover, i.audio_url as audioUrl, false as up from recite_recent_play rrp join recite_playlist_item i on i.id = rrp.media_id where rrp.user_id = #{userId} and rrp.media_id is not null group by i.id, i.playlist_id, i.poem_id, i.item_title, i.item_subtitle, i.cover_url, i.audio_url order by max(rrp.play_time) desc limit 20

select rpv.id, rpv.title, rpv.author, rpv.thumbnail, rpv.video_url as videoUrl, rpv.duration, rpv.quality, rpv.views, rpv.tags, rpv.description from recite_recent_video rrv join recite_playlist_video rpv on rpv.id = rrv.video_id where rrv.user_id = #{userId} group by rpv.id, rpv.title, rpv.author, rpv.thumbnail, rpv.video_url, rpv.duration, rpv.quality, rpv.views, rpv.tags, rpv.description order by max(rrv.play_time) desc limit 20

select i.id, i.playlist_id as playlistId, i.poem_id as poemId, i.item_title as title, i.item_subtitle as subtitle, i.cover_url as cover, i.audio_url as audioUrl, true as up from recite_playlist_item i order by ( select count(1) from recite_record r where r.media_id = i.id ) desc, i.id desc limit 8

select i.id, i.playlist_id as playlistId, i.poem_id as poemId, i.item_title as title, i.item_subtitle as subtitle, i.cover_url as cover, i.audio_url as audioUrl, false as up from recite_playlist_item i where i.id not in ( select t.id from ( select hi.id from recite_playlist_item hi order by ( select count(1) from recite_record hr where hr.media_id = hi.id ) desc, hi.id desc limit 8 ) t ) order by ( select count(1) from recite_record r where r.media_id = i.id ) desc, i.id desc limit 8
mapper.insert: insert into recite_record ( user_id, poem_id, playlist_id, media_id, play_type, play_seconds, created_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{poemId}, #{playlistId}, #{mediaId}, #{playType}, 0, now() )
insert into recite_recent_play ( user_id, playlist_id, poem_id, media_id, play_type, play_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{playlistId}, #{poemId}, #{mediaId}, #{playType}, now() )
insert into recite_video_record ( user_id, video_id, playlist_id, play_seconds, play_type, created_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{videoId}, #{playlistId}, #{playSeconds}, #{playType}, now() )

insert into recite_recent_video ( user_id, video_id, playlist_id, play_type, play_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{videoId}, #{playlistId}, #{playType}, now() ) on duplicate key update playlist_id = #{playlistId}, play_type = #{playType}, play_time = now()
insert into recite_favorite ( user_id, target_id, favorite_type, create_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{targetId}, #{favoriteType}, now() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, poem_id as poemId, title, poet_name as poetName, dynasty, content, difficulty_level as difficultyLevel, recommended_duration as recommendedDuration, emotion_type as emotionType, is_featured as isFeatured FROM recite_poem_selection WHERE id = #{id}
